name: cache-warmer
description: Keeps an idle session's prompt cache warm with silent pings, then compacts large sessions once while the cache is still warm.

pingIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between keep-alive pings; keep it under the cache lifetime
pingIntervalMinutes.title: Ping interval (minutes)

cacheTtlMinutes.description: Prompt cache lifetime in minutes (60 on this account)
cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)

warmHours.description: How many idle hours to keep the cache warm before stopping
warmHours.title: Warm window (hours)

minPingContextK.description: Smallest context, in thousands of tokens, worth pinging
minPingContextK.title: Minimum context to ping (k tokens)

minCompactContextK.description: Context, in thousands of tokens, above which the session is compacted when the warm window ends
minCompactContextK.title: Minimum context to compact (k tokens)

dailyBudgetK.description: Daily keep-alive budget across all sessions, in thousands of full-price token equivalents
dailyBudgetK.title: Daily keep-alive budget (k equivalents)
